items.title: datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang
items.excerpt: Official SGLang x Datawhale course on LLM inference: understand inference, build a mini-sglang from scratch, then read the real SGLang source and land your first PR. Available in English and Chinese.
items.summary: Official SGLang x Datawhale course teaches LLM inference fundamentals, mini-implementation from scratch, then reading real SGLang source to land first PR. Available in English and Chinese.
items.usefulness: If building Python inference tools, understanding SGLang internals could help optimize token generation or integrate structured outputs.
items.to_verify: Whether the course actually teaches buildable inference patterns versus survey-level overview; what inference concepts the mini-implementation covers.

items.title: 2akouwu/reverify
items.excerpt: Stop your AI from making things up — it proposes, deterministic tools decide, every claim checked against ground truth with evidence. Grounded facts and context survive resets. Reverse engineering is the proving ground. MCP server + CLI.
items.summary: Reverify stops AI hallucination by having agents propose claims, deterministic tools validate against ground truth with evidence. MCP server plus CLI. Claims grounded facts survive resets.
items.usefulness: If analyzing documents with AI, deterministic fact-checking against external truth sources could reduce false citations in summaries or extracted facts.
items.to_verify: How ground truth is sourced and maintained; whether evidence matching handles paraphrasing; what happens when sources conflict or are unavailable.

items.title: bojieli/ai-infra-book
items.excerpt: 《深入理解 AI Infra：量化分析与系统设计》（李博杰 著）开源书稿：从硬件约束和模型架构出发，量化推导 LLM 推理与训练系统设计。含全书正文、PDF、配套计算工具与实验
items.summary: Chinese open-source book on AI infrastructure: quantitative analysis from hardware constraints and model architecture through LLM inference and training system design. Includes tools and experiments.
items.usefulness: If designing Python tools for model serving or training, understanding quantitative tradeoffs between batch size, precision and latency could inform architecture choices.
items.to_verify: Whether quantitative derivations are reproducible; which hardware constraints and model sizes the tools cover; if experiments verify theoretical predictions.

economia|asia.title: US says China talks yield progress on tariff carve-outs, AI dialogue
economia|asia.summary: US officials reported progress in talks with China on tariff carve-outs and artificial intelligence dialogue. The discussions aim to address trade tensions and technology cooperation between the two countries.

economia|asia.title: Chinese rare earth shipments to US drop ahead of Trump-Xi summit
economia|asia.summary: Chinese rare earth exports to the US dropped 20% in August from July as Washington pressures Beijing over critical mineral supplies. The decline occurs ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.

economia|asia.title: Vietnam enters FTSE emerging-market ranks, eyes billions in inflows
economia|asia.summary: Vietnam entered the FTSE emerging-market index, positioning itself to attract billions in foreign investment inflows. The inclusion reflects growing recognition of Vietnam's economic significance.

economia|europa.title: ECB to invest part of own funds in tokenised securities, with settlement via Pontes
economia|europa.summary: The ECB will invest part of its own funds in tokenised securities with settlement through Pontes. The initiative advances the central bank's exploration of blockchain-based financial infrastructure.

economia|europa.title: La inversión extranjera en España se dispara en la primera mitad del año y roza los 12.500 millones de euros
economia|europa.summary: La inversión extranjera en España creció 30% anual en el primer semestre, alcanzando casi 12.500 millones de euros, aunque aún está por debajo de niveles de 2024. El Gobierno busca reforzar el control de estas operaciones.

economia|europa.title: Irlanda multa a Google con 403 millones por infringir la normativa de protección de datos
economia|europa.summary: Irlanda multa a Google con 403 millones de euros por violar normativas de protección de datos. La autoridad concluyó que la empresa incumplió en el tratamiento de localización entre 2018 y 2020.

economia|america.title: Brazil Economists Lower 2026 Selic Forecast Following Rate Cut
economia|america.summary: Brazilian economists lowered their 2026 year-end Selic forecast following recent rate cuts as the economy gradually cools. The adjustment reflects expectations ahead of next month's presidential election.

economia|america.title: Trump-Xi Summit Prep Gathers Pace as Officials Make Headway on AI, Trade
economia|america.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent reported 'very successful' talks with Chinese officials on AI and trade ahead of the Trump-Xi summit. Officials are making headway on technology and economic cooperation.

politica|asia.title: China confirms Xi’s first trip to U.S. in nearly three years
politica|asia.summary: China confirmed President Xi Jinping's first visit to the US in nearly three years, scheduled for this week. The visit comes as a one-year trade truce between the countries approaches expiration.

politica|asia.title: Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay state visit to US this week, Beijing confirms
politica|asia.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping will conduct a state visit to the United States from Wednesday to Friday, China's foreign ministry confirmed. The visit marks significant diplomatic engagement between the two countries.

politica|asia.title: Nearly half of Taiwanese lack confidence in US defence commitments, survey finds
politica|asia.summary: Nearly half of Taiwanese respondents lack confidence in US defence commitments, according to a new survey. Concerns focus on Washington's continued military aid and arms sales to the island.

politica|asia.title: China expels generals accused of graft from Communist Party: State media
politica|asia.summary: China expelled high-ranking military officials Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli from the Communist Party for corruption involving exceptionally large sums. State media released details of their cases for the first time.

politica|europa.title: German regional elections: Chancellor Merz and his party suffer historic defeat
politica|europa.summary: German Chancellor Merz's CDU party suffered a historic defeat in regional elections, falling below 5% in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. The result marked the first time since 1949 the party fell below this threshold regionally.

politica|europa.title: Ireland fines Google €403 million on behalf of EU for location data breach
politica|europa.summary: Ireland fined Google €403 million on behalf of the EU for location data privacy violations. The regulator determined Google failed to properly disclose how location data influenced advertising.

politica|europa.title: Far-right AfD's rise in Germany's regional elections worries EU
politica|europa.summary: The far-right AfD's gains in German regional elections concern EU partners worried about Berlin turning inward. The party's rise fuels distrust and concern among neighbouring countries.

politica|europa.title: Kremlin orchestrates Russian elections by manipulating votes and barring observers
politica|europa.summary: The Kremlin orchestrated Russia's elections through vote manipulation and observer restrictions, according to journalists and observers reporting from polling stations. Irregularities occurred during the three-day voting period ending Sunday.

politica|europa.title: Trump to meet Macron in New York on sidelines of UN General Assembly
politica|europa.summary: Trump will meet French President Macron in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. The meeting is scheduled for 5:35 pm according to Trump's published schedule.

politica|america.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
politica|america.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres returns for his final General Assembly as world leaders converge this week. Diplomacy faces challenges amid ongoing wars in Ukraine and the Middle East.

politica|america.title: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
politica|america.summary: World leaders convene for the UN General Assembly this week as wars continue in Ukraine and the Gulf. Trump has proposed converting a DC arch into a military complex.

politica|america.title: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.
politica|america.summary: Eighteen suspects arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were extradited to the US on Sunday. They will face justice in Florida for the assassination.

politica|america.title: Las tensiones entre México y Estados Unidos por la “narcopolítica” entran en campaña
politica|america.summary: Las tensiones entre México y Estados Unidos por narcopolítica escalaron en campañas electorales. Trump amplifica argumentos sobre crimen organizado en México, mientras Sheinbaum rechaza injerencias estadounidenses.

politica|america.title: Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
politica|america.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz vowed to continue reforms despite a historic state election defeat where his CDU lost ground. The far-right AfD made significant gains in the regional elections.

tecnologia|america.title: US and China Discuss Alerting Each Other to AI National Security Threats
tecnologia|america.summary: US and Chinese officials discussed establishing a mechanism to alert each other of AI incidents threatening national security. The talks advance cooperation on artificial intelligence governance between the two countries.

tecnologia|america.title: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
tecnologia|america.summary: Google's threat intelligence group infiltrated TeamPCP, a notorious supply-chain hacking gang, with an undercover analyst. The operation provided intelligence on the criminal organization's activities.

tecnologia|america.title: UN says AI safeguards can’t wait for certainty
tecnologia|america.summary: A UN scientific panel warned that AI safeguards cannot wait for complete certainty about risks. Governments must regulate increasingly capable AI agents before their full impacts are understood.

tecnologia|america.title: Trump now says he wants to form an ‘AI Force’
tecnologia|america.summary: Trump announced plans to form an 'AI Force' and appoint an 'AI czar' to lead the initiative on Truth Social. The announcement comes amid growing political pressure for AI oversight.

tecnologia|europa.title: Una idea ha tomado fuerza el fin de semana: suenan tambores de guerra en Europa, y una isla del Báltico está avisando al resto
tecnologia|europa.summary: Debates europeos intensifican preocupaciones sobre conflicto entre Rusia y la OTAN durante el fin de semana. Una isla del Báltico advierte al resto de Europa sobre posibles tensiones militares.

tecnologia|europa.title: Is the AI industry really ready to slow down?
tecnologia|europa.summary: Industry discussions question whether AI executives are genuinely committed to slowing development and deployment. Equity debates focus on the sincerity of calls for reduced AI expansion pace.

tecnologia|asia.title: 軟銀砸 100 億美元加碼 OpenAI！發行 110 億美元債券籌資
tecnologia|asia.summary: 软银集团周一公布发行100亿美元及11.5亿美元债券的计划，用于加码投资OpenAI。这笔融资反映软银继续加强在AI领域的战略布局。

tecnologia|asia.title: 路透：中國監管機構對尋求上市人型機器人企業踩煞車
tecnologia|asia.summary: 中国监管机构对寻求上市的人型机器人企业进行审查，重点关注企业估值和官方支持情况。监管部门对行业快速发展采取谨慎态度。

tecnologia|asia.title: Anthropic 跨足生物研究，自建實驗室瞄準罕病新療法
tecnologia|asia.summary: Anthropic在旧金山湾区建立湿式实验室，探索利用Claude进行生物研究以开发罕病疗法。该举措标志着AI公司进入生命科学领域的新尝试。
